sentences.text: This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.541/2022 dated 27.12.2022 registered at Police Station Raipur Karchuliyan, District Rewa for the offences punishable under Sections 376(3) of IPC and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children From Sexual Offences Act.

1 evident from paragraph 3 of the cross-examination of the prosecutrix in which she has unequivocally stated that the parents of the prosecutrix had asked the mother and sister of the present applicant to return the articles which were stolen and it was further stated by her in paragraph 9 that if the articles were returned, there would not have been any FIR under the offences for which the present applicant is being prosecuted.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the age of the applicant is about 22 years and he is in custody since 28.12.2022 and trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be released on bail.
3. Per contra, the counsel for the State has opposed the aforesaid prayer for grant of bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, the period of incarceration of the applicant i.e 28/12/2022 and looking to the paragraphs 3 and 9 of prosecutrix testimony, prima facie it indicates that on account of incident of theft, parents of the prosecutrix had suspension that the present applicant was involved in commission of theft, therefore, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard by that Court during the pendency of trial.

7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
